mapper.sql: ci.id, ci.class_name, ci.grade, ci.major, ci.head_teacher_id, ci.remark
mapper.select: SELECT , t.name AS head_teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student s WHERE s.class_id = ci.id) AS student_count FROM class_info ci LEFT JOIN teacher t ON ci.head_teacher_id = t.id ORDER BY ci.id ASC

SELECT , t.name AS head_teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student s WHERE s.class_id = ci.id) AS student_count FROM class_info ci LEFT JOIN teacher t ON ci.head_teacher_id = t.id WHERE ci.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_info (class_name, grade, major, head_teacher_id, remark) VALUES (#{className}, #{grade}, #{major}, #{headTeacherId}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_info WHERE class_name = #{className} AND id != #{excludeId}
